image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a pile of cooked Dungeness crabs. The crabs are stacked on top of each other, filling the frame. They exhibit the characteristic orange-red coloration of cooked crustaceans. The ventral side (underside) of several crabs is visible, showing the folded abdomen and leg attachments. The claws and walking legs are prominent, with some overlapping due to the stacking.

Some leg segments appear to merge or fade into adjacent legs without clear joint articulation. The anatomy becomes ambiguous in the dense pile, with some legs appearing to terminate abruptly or fuse with the background crab.
